stage: before FIT detector extraction and before any R04 test extraction or scoring
rationale: Normal FIT 01/03 show the hinged metal part moving relative to cardboard. Use its coordinate frame as anchor and cardboard as target. Keep the third trough role for appearance crops.
qualitative_limitations: Cardboard is absent in some normal frames and multiple cut pieces can coexist.
Metal lid and trough may be visually confused.
Role observations and learned clusters have no ground-truth accuracy labels.
Qwen state order is a hypothesis; relational cluster states replace semantic assignments.
